title: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals announced results from Part 2a of the DENALI Phase 2 clinical trial, selecting 400mg once daily on a 5-days-on, 2-days-off schedule (400mg QD 5:2) as the optimal monotherapy dose of azenosertib for Cyclin E1-positive platinum-resistant ovarian cancer based on a prespecified interim analysis showing a differentiated response rate over the 300mg dose with comparable safety. The company expects to initiate the confirmatory ASPENOVA Phase 3 trial in Q2 2026.
key_points: Zentalis selected 400mg QD 5:2 as optimal monotherapy dose of azenosertib based on prespecified interim analysis from DENALI Part 2a
Part 2a compared 300mg QD 5:2 and 400mg QD 5:2 with approximately 30 patients per dose group; 300mg arm discontinued
400mg dose showed meaningful and clearly differentiated response rate compared to 300mg with comparable safety profiles
Company expects to initiate ASPENOVA Phase 3 clinical trial in Q2 2026 for Cyclin E1-positive platinum-resistant ovarian cancer
DENALI Part 2 expanded with new Part 2c cohort to include patients previously treated with taxane-containing regimen
Company expects to complete enrollment and provide topline readout for DENALI Part 2 by year-end 2026
Existing cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities expected to fund operations into late 2027
why_it_matters: This 8-K filing announces clinically significant data from a Phase 2 trial for Zentalis's lead drug candidate azenosertib. The selection of an optimal dose clears a key development milestone and enables advancement to a registration-directed Phase 3 trial, which is material for Zentalis shareholders and biotech investors tracking this oncology program.
